qa_pairs.question: My order status just changed to Packing. Can I still cancel it?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Once an order is in Packing, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but the interception fee is non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, you must use the return process after delivery.

contexts.text: Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, the customer must use the return process after delivery.

qa_pairs.question: I want to buy a USD 400 NovaBook 14 with OrbitPay instalments. How does the plan work, and can I use a gift card for the first payment?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitPay instalments are available for eligible device purchases of at least USD 300 after discounts, so a USD 400 device qualifies. You pay 25% at checkout (USD 100) and then three equal monthly payments. Gift cards cannot be used for the initial 25% payment.

contexts.text: OrbitPay instalments are available for eligible device purchases of at least USD 300 after discounts. The plan requires 25% at checkout and three equal monthly payments. Gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%.

qa_pairs.question: My package has had no tracking updates since its estimated delivery date. When is it considered delayed, and what happens next?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. Support may then open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while the trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.

contexts.text: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. At that point, support may open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.

qa_pairs.question: I paid for an order with a gift card plus my credit card and I am returning it. How will I be refunded?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: After inspection, the refund goes to the original payment methods within five to seven business days. The card-funded portion returns to the credit card, while the gift-card portion cannot be refunded as cash and is returned to a replacement gift card.

contexts.text: After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days. Gift-card portions return to a replacement gift card.
OrbitTech cannot refund cash for a gift-card-funded portion; that amount returns to a replacement gift card.

qa_pairs.question: My device is out of warranty. How does a paid repair work, and what if I decide not to go ahead?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitTech sends a written quote, which is valid for seven calendar days. Work begins only after you approve it and make any required payment. If you decline, a USD 35 diagnostic fee applies, unless remote support confirmed before shipment that no diagnostic fee would be charged.

contexts.text: For an out-of-warranty or excluded issue, OrbitTech sends a written quote. The quote remains valid for seven calendar days. Work begins only after approval and required payment. If the customer declines, a diagnostic fee of USD 35 applies unless remote support confirmed before shipment that no diagnostic fee would be charged.

qa_pairs.question: I think my account was hacked and there is an order I did not place that is still Confirmed. What should I do?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Reset your password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. Because the unauthorized order is still Confirmed, you should also try to cancel it from your account page. If it reaches packing or dispatch, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams, but cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If an unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`, the customer should also attempt cancellation under `02_orders_and_payments.md`.
If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams; cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.
An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`.

qa_pairs.question: When can I file a formal service complaint, and what should it include?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: You can file a formal complaint after the assigned team misses a published response period or closes a case without addressing the stated issue. Include the case number, the resolution you want, and relevant evidence. A supervisor reviews it within five business days.

contexts.text: A formal service complaint may be filed after the assigned team misses a published response period or closes a case without addressing the stated issue. The complaint should identify the case number, requested resolution, and relevant evidence. A supervisor reviews it within five business days.

qa_pairs.question: I placed an order for a PulsePhone X on August 25, 2026 while I was an OrbitPlus member. It was delivered on August 28 and is still unopened. Can I return it on September 20, 2026?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The order was placed before September 1, 2026, so Return Policy version 1.0 applies, which allows 21 calendar days for unopened devices counted from confirmed delivery. The window ended on September 18, so September 20 (day 23) is too late. The 30-day version 2.0 window and the 45-day OrbitPlus extension do not apply, because orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day window regardless of membership.

contexts.text: For return-policy eligibility, the triggering event is the order-placement date, while the number of return days is counted from confirmed delivery.

Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices, seven calendar days for opened devices, and charged a 15% opened-device restocking fee.
Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership.

qa_pairs.question: I ordered a NovaBook 14 on September 5, 2026 as an active OrbitPlus member. I opened it and it works fine, but I changed my mind 12 days after delivery. Can I return it, and will I get a full refund?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Yes, but not a full refund. An opened standard device can be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery, so day 12 is within the window, but a 10% restocking fee applies because it is not defective. Original standard-shipping fees are not refunded for preference returns. OrbitPlus does not change this, because it does not extend the 14-day opened-device window.

contexts.text: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.
Original standard-shipping fees are not refunded for preference returns.
It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty.

qa_pairs.question: I dropped my PulsePhone X and cracked the screen. If I buy OrbitPlus now, will the repair be covered under warranty?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The warranty excludes accidental impact, and buying OrbitPlus after the incident does not convert accidental damage into a warranty claim. The phone may still be repairable for a fee: OrbitTech sends a written quote for an excluded issue, and work begins only after you approve it and pay.

contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.
Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee, but it is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident.
For an out-of-warranty or excluded issue, OrbitTech sends a written quote.
Work begins only after approval and required payment.

qa_pairs.question: I ordered a NovaBook 14 bundle on September 10, 2026 that came with free AeroBuds Pro. The laptop is still unopened and within 30 days of delivery. Can I return only the laptop and keep the earbuds?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle. You may return the unopened laptop within its 30-day window, but if you keep the free AeroBuds Pro, their stated promotional value is deducted from your refund. This deduction applies even though the laptop itself is within the return window.

contexts.text: A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle. If a customer keeps a free gift or one bundled item, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund. This rule also applies when the main device is otherwise within the return window described in `05_returns_and_exchanges.md`.
For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery.

qa_pairs.question: The charging port on my NovaBook 14 was replaced under warranty in month 23 of its warranty. How long is the new part covered, and does my laptop get a fresh 24-month warranty?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14 has a 24-month warranty, so only about one month of the original warranty remains. Replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty, so the new port is covered for 90 calendar days. The laptop does not get a new 24-month warranty.

contexts.text: OrbitTech provides a 24-month limited hardware warranty for the NovaBook 14, PulsePhone X, and HomeHub Mini.
Replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty.
A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty.

qa_pairs.question: Since OrbitPlus gives members a 60-day return window on all devices, can I return my opened NovaBook 14 that was delivered 40 days ago?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The premise is incorrect: OrbitPlus does not provide a 60-day return window. It extends only the unopened-device window, from 30 to 45 calendar days, and does not extend the 14-day opened-device window. An opened NovaBook 14 delivered 40 days ago is outside the return window. If the laptop is defective, warranty service may apply instead.

contexts.text: It must not invent a product specification, delivery status, discount, or legal right.
OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active.
It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty.

The warranty is separate from the return policy. A customer inside the return window may choose an eligible return; after that window, a covered defect follows the repair process in `07_repair_and_technical_support.md`.
